description: Customer decision bolt-review milestone storage (CD-10, libs/core/mission/mission-bolt-review.ts): when a mission starts, lists agendas/ of the bound tenant's decision case, reads the agenda files and writes only agendas/<agenda_id>.json (milestones_passed of open bolt-review agendas) under knowledge/confidential/<tenant>/decisions/<case>/. Requires an exact deny-only case capability (libs/core/foundation/customer-decision-milestone-capability.ts) naming every path before each operation; tenant-bound (libs/core/authority.ts TENANT_BOUND_READER_ROLES). No ledger, receipt, switch, consumer, attachment, invite or customers/ authority.
